decision.reason: At first1k, normalization augmentation gives small positive photographic/procedural source means and lower bias/RMSE in16 of18 fixed hue groups. It does not establish useful real-photo superiority: weak texture remains missing, both candidates lose selected bright carrier response relative to their parent, and bright neutral/saturated hue groups regress versus control. These mixed early results justify completing the original matched4000 horizon, not promotion or a larger training budget.
decision.next_step: Complete the original matched4,000-update schedules from the genuine first1k model/EMA/Adam/RNG states, preserving the original LR curve, seed, data, frozen source and normalization policies. Use separate continuation run directories to keep first1k logs/checkpoints and this review immutable. Review full photographic, paired, analytic, hue, GFX/native crops and source sensitivities at4k before any promotion. No additional training budget or corpus change is authorized by this decision.
